Preserve source commit, exact Git blobs, packet hash, receipt availability,30-minute packet age and5-minute future-skew policy before attributing current acceptance; a newer unaccepted packet is not a code failure by itself.

Canonical local research Brain sync requires a clean exact source revision and retains causal, multiple-testing, latency, ablation, calibration, OOD, deterministic-rerun and independent-review gates as unresolved where its workflow does not establish them. LearningFabric.intelligence_snapshot is a read-only receipt-timed forecast consumer and explicitly does not harvest, train or settle on read. Observatory evidence is bounded fixture/engineering observation with live_engine=not_observed; causal-router is synthetic research assurance. None of those artifacts establishes a deployed engine, empirical alpha, automatic model promotion or live-order authority.
